what: HUPHY LegOnly biped (12 motors) stands on flat ground and holds a commanded pelvis height h*.
target_pos_rad: target = offset_rad + scale_rad_per_unit * action, then clipped to clip_rad (the action itself is NOT clipped; last_action is the unclipped raw value)

observations.definition: IMU angular velocity in the IMU frame (+x forward, +y left, +z up). The IMU site imu_in_base has the base_link orientation (no rotation; pos -0.000001, 0.007078, -0.0695 m in base_link), so this is the pelvis angular velocity in the pelvis frame. Raw, no scale.

Direction of gravity expressed in the IMU frame; (0, 0, -1) when upright. = R_world_imu^T (0, 0, -1). The sim sensor gives the world UP axis in the IMU frame and the observation negates it. Not the accelerometer reading.
observations.sim_sensor: -robot/imu_upvector (MuJoCo framezaxis of world in site imu_in_base)

observations.definition: Motor encoder angle minus default pose angle (offset_rad of the same joint), 12 motors in joint_names order, 2 frames laid out [previous frame 12][current frame 12] (oldest first). Previous = the reading of the previous 20 ms control step. After a reset both frames are the first reading. Cranks: the crank MOTOR angle, not the ankle angle.
Raw network output of the previous control step (before scale / offset / clip), same order as `actions`. Zeros after a reset.
Target pelvis height h* in metres, unscaled, no offset. Clipped to h_star.range_m by the deploy code.

h_star.definition: pelvis (base_link frame origin) height above the flat ground the feet stand on: z_base_link_origin - z_ground. Not the CoM, not the IMU height (the IMU site is 0.0695 m below the base_link origin).
h_star.default_pose_height_note: base_link origin height with the default pose and the soles flat on the ground (geometry, assets/linkage_table.npz). Start with this h*.
h_star.out_of_range: clipped to range_m, one warning printed until the next reset()
h_star.training_profile: step changes every 3-6 s to a uniform value in range_m

frames.body: +x forward, +y left, +z up (pelvis / base_link = IMU frame)
frames.joint_sign: positive joint angle = right-hand rotation about the joint axis in motor_params.json (joint_axis_in_parent_link); L joints are the mirror of R: hip pitch / roll / yaw, knee, crank A / B all have q_L = -q_R in the mirrored pose
frames.zero: joint angle 0 = the zero of the MJCF model the policy was trained on; the real encoders must be calibrated to the same zero and sign. The default pose is NOT zero (default_pose_rad)

notes: actions, the encoder history and last_action all use the same 12-motor order (model order).
the observation carries encoder angles RELATIVE to offset_rad, two frames, oldest first.
the ONNX graph contains the empirical observation normalizer; obs_normalizer_* are diagnostic.

golden.how: actor obs from the training env (full DR, pushes, obs noise, obs/command lags, h* resampling) driven by this checkpoint; 4 right after reset, 20 at random steps 25-400; actions = torch actor output (deterministic mean, raw, before scale/offset/clip). Feed obs to the ONNX as is (float32).
